blog.title: Amazon S3 Tables now support all Apache Iceberg V3 data types
blog.description: Amazon S3 Tables now support all data types in the Apache Iceberg V3 spec, along with column default values, deletion vectors, and row lineage. Upgrade existing V2 tables or create new V3 tables with built-in compaction, maintenance, and engine compatibility.

blog.title: Amazon S3 Vectors now supports metadata pre-filtering for higher recall on filtered searches
blog.description: Amazon S3 Vectors now supports metadata pre filtering, delivering up to 5x higher recall on filtered searches. Filters evaluate before similarity search so scoped queries return more relevant results. Ideal for RAG, agentic apps, and document search.
